**Description**

> [!CAUTION]
> **Current**

> AND I have added another shape component to it
> WHEN I delete the whole entity
> THEN the entity stays in the scene

> [!TIP]
> **Expected**
> GIVEN I have added a game object to the scene
> AND I have added another shape component to it
